payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Assess whether the requested placement is fulfilled, rather than treating frogs on the lid, tank, or floor as fulfillment.
outcome.target: The frog's location relative to the toilet bowl.
outcome.reference: The toilet and surrounding area in the source image.

check.question: Are any frogs placed only outside the bowl, such as on the lid, tank, or floor, rather than inside it?
check.complete_when: No; any visible frogs relevant to the request are inside the bowl.
check.partial_when: Yes; one or more frogs are outside the bowl, even if another frog is inside it.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no frog has been added anywhere in the toilet area.
check.unknown_when: The locations of visible frogs cannot be assessed reliably.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"Several frogs were added, but some are outside the bowl: one is on the raised lid and another is on the floor. A frog is also inside the bowl."}
